data.name: Deewan
data.gender_notes: Deewan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Deewan is a title used in various Muslim cultures to refer to a high-ranking official or advisor. It signifies a person of great importance and wisdom. The name Deewan carries the meaning “Chief or Royal Advisor” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Deewan usually hope their child will grow to embody chief or royal advisor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Encouragement and guidance on the path to spiritual growth and enlightenment
data.etymology: Deewan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Chief or Royal Advisor.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Deewan total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: ديوان
in_arabic.meaning: ديوان هو مكان للنظر في الأمور الحكومية
in_arabic.long_meaning: الديوان هو اسم يعود إلى الكلمة العربية التي تعني مكانًا للنظر في الأمور الحكومية أو القضائية، ويرتبط بالعديد من المعاني منها كونه مجلسًا للنظر في الشؤون أو كتابًا يحتوي على أسماء الأشخاص المعنيين بالشؤون الحكومية. وقد وردت هذه الكلمة في القرآن الكريم ضمن سياقات مختلفة.

in_urdu.name: دیوان
in_urdu.meaning: دیوان کا مطلب ہے جہاں سرکاری امور دیکھے جاتے ہیں
in_urdu.long_meaning: دیوان ایک عربی لفظ ہے جو ایسی جگہ یا مقام کو کہا جاتا ہے جہاں سرکاری یا انتظامی امور پر غور کیا جاتا ہے۔ اس کا استعمال فارسی اور اردو میں بھی مختلف سیاق واقف میں کیا گیا ہے۔ دیوان کے معنی فارسی میں 'مجلس' یا 'کچہری' کے بھی ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: दीवान
in_hindi.meaning: दीवान का अर्थ है जहां सरकारी मामले देखे जाते हैं
in_hindi.long_meaning: दीवान एक ऐसा शब्द है जो सरकारी कार्यों के प्रबंधन के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है। यह शब्द फारसी और अरबी भाषाओं से आया है और अक्सर एक ऐसी संस्था या सभा को इंगित करता है जो शासन और प्रशासन से संबंधित मामलों पर विचार करती है।

in_pashto.name: دیوان
in_pashto.meaning: دیوان د دولتي چارو د کتنې ځای دی
in_pashto.long_meaning: دیوان په پښتو او نورو ژبو کې هغه ځای یا دفتر ته ویل کیږي چي د دولتي او حکومتي چارو لپاره کار کوي. دا کلمه د عربي او فارسي کلمو څخه اخیستل شوې ده او په مختلفو مفهومو کارول شوې ده.

in_english.name: Deewan
in_english.meaning: A place or council for administrative or governmental matters
in_english.long_meaning: The term 'Deewan' originates from Arabic, referring to a council, court, or place where administrative or governmental matters are discussed. It has been used in various contexts across Islamic history, including as a high-ranking official title. The root 'D-W-N' in Arabic relates to the concepts of judging, deciding, and governing.

data.cultural_impact: The title "Deewan" holds great cultural significance, especially in South Asian Muslim communities. Deewans were historically responsible for managing the various affairs of a ruler or a king, acting as their chief advisors, or viziers, at times even holding political power. The title also extends to those who excel in poetry, often called the "Poet Laureate" or "Poet Deewan," who were revered for their literacy and artistic skills, adding to their prestige among the society.
data.spiritual_significance: Moreover, the title "Deewan" gains spiritual significance through diverse interpretations. In the context of Sufi poetry, "Deewan" signifies a spiritual guide, sharpening one's understanding of the divine by providing sacred knowledge and nourishment for the soul. In a broader sense, every Muslim man striving to implement Islamic teachings and living a pious life is considered a Deewan, a repository of God's wisdom. Deewan’s primary function is to uphold knowledge, wisdom and character, radiating a spiritual aura befitting such a revered title.
